breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly defines and applies the factor of safety as n = Sy / σ_avg (yield strength divided by working stress), with σ_avg in the denominator. This matches the ground truth definition. The incomplete prompt had incorrectly described the formula as n = σ_avg / S_y (working stress in the numerator), but the agent fixed this inconsistency and used the correct formulation throughout.
